note: User-facing copy for the AI content detector (English). Kept in data/ so wording changes do not require code edits. v2 adds the UX-overhaul keys (interpretations, gates, error cards, span hints, C2PA strings) per docs detector-ux-map.
disclaimer: This is a probabilistic signal, not proof. AI detectors produce false positives — especially on short texts, non-native English writing, and heavily edited AI output. Never use this result as the sole basis for accusations, grading, moderation, or legal decisions.
shortDisclaimer: Probabilistic signal, not proof. False positives happen — do not use as the sole basis for decisions.

interpretationByStatus.confident_ai: Both the score and its confidence interval sit in the high-AI zone. This is a strong statistical signal, not proof.
interpretationByStatus.likely_ai: The score leans AI, but the confidence interval is wide. Treat this as a hint, not a verdict.
interpretationByStatus.insufficient_data: The score falls in the zone where detectors are unreliable, so we refuse to pick a side.
interpretationByStatus.likely_human: The score leans human, within a wide interval. A paraphrased or edited AI text can land here too.
interpretationByStatus.confident_human: Strong statistical signal of human writing.

verdictActions.confident_ai: → Check the highlighted segments below — they show what drove the score.
verdictActions.likely_ai: → Look at the highlighted segments; mixed highlighting usually means mixed origin.
verdictActions.insufficient_data: → Send a longer sample, or the same text before/after editing, to get out of the grey zone.
verdictActions.likely_human: → If authorship matters, ask for drafts or edit history — no detector can prove authorship.
verdictActions.confident_human: → Still not proof of authorship — see honest limits below.

abstainBlock.title: How to get a verdict
items: Send a longer sample — 400+ words move most texts out of the grey zone.
Send an earlier or later version of the same text — edited and raw versions rarely sit in the grey zone together.
For images, send the original file with metadata intact (see the Image tab).

firstVisitHints.title: How to get a reliable verdict
firstVisitHints.text: Paste 150+ words of continuous prose — the more, the tighter the confidence interval.
firstVisitHints.code: Paste 40+ non-empty lines of one file, not a diff or a snippet.
firstVisitHints.image: Upload the original file, not a screenshot or a messenger re-save — they strip the metadata we read.
firstVisitHints.returnLink: First time? How to get a reliable verdict

gates.tooShortCode: Too short — {lines} of {min} non-empty lines minimum
gates.tooLongText: Over the limit — {words} words, maximum {max}. Keep the most representative chapters and re-run.
gates.tooLongCode: Over the limit — {chars} characters, maximum {max}. Paste a single file, not the whole repo.
gates.shortReason: Short inputs are refused on purpose: below the minimum every known detector is noise. See “Honest limits”.

noMl.body: Our scoring layer is not available on this deployment (no ML provider configured), so no verdict can be produced — for any input. This is a limitation of this server, not a property of your text.
noMl.working: Image provenance checks (C2PA) run locally in your browser and still work — switch to the Image tab if you have a file to verify.
noMl.action: → Nothing to retry on your side. Check /methodology for what the full pipeline looks like when configured.

imgNoSignals.body: This image carries no provenance metadata, and the external image detector is not configured on this deployment — there is nothing reliable to score.
imgNoSignals.misread: Absence of metadata is not evidence of human origin — metadata is trivially stripped by re-saving.
imgNoSignals.hintsTitle: How to get a verdict for an image
hints: Send the original file straight from the generator or camera — not a screenshot or a messenger re-save.
If the image came from a C2PA-signing tool (Firefly, DALL·E, some cameras), the original will verify locally in your browser.

rateLimit.title: Rate limit reached
rateLimit.body: 30 checks per hour per visitor. Your input is still in the form — come back when the timer runs out.
rateLimit.timerDone: The window has passed — you can retry now.
rateLimit.imageNote: C2PA signature checks run in your browser and do not count against the limit — you can still verify signed files.

errors.title: Check failed
errors.network: No connection to the server. Your text is safe in the form — retry when you're back online.
errors.server: The detection service returned an error (HTTP {status}). This is on our side; retry in a moment.
errors.badImage: the image could not be read — try re-saving it as PNG or JPEG

spanHints.title: Segment analysis
spanHints.subtitle: Per-sentence scores from the zero-shot layer — this is the evidence behind the verdict, not per-sentence verdicts.
spanHints.legend: Darker shading = more AI-like · tap or hover a segment for its score

borderlineExtNote: Borderline score — an independent external detector (Sapling) was consulted and the confidence interval was widened to cover both opinions.
attributionEnglishNote: Model-family guess is English-only and was skipped for this text. The verdict itself is language-independent.
attributionFootnote: Family-level guess, English only — not an identification of a specific model.
extOnlyNote: Based on a single external signal — our own scoring layer is not configured on this deployment. Treat with extra caution.
c2paInvalidNote: Invalid ≠ AI-generated: re-saving in an editor breaks signatures too.
c2paNoAiNote: This does not prove the content is human-made — it proves the manifest says so.

submitting.slow: Scoring ~{n} tokens under two models — long inputs take up to ~20 s.

c2pa.signedAiFact: Cryptographically signed as AI-generated{byGenerator}. Verified locally — this file was never uploaded.
c2pa.signedNoAiFact: Valid C2PA signature{byGenerator}. The signer declares no AI involvement (e.g. a camera-signed photo). Verified locally — not uploaded.
c2pa.signedAiAction: → No further check needed — a valid signature outranks any statistical detector.
c2pa.signedNoAiAction: → Provenance is verified; what the content is, the signer already declared. Nothing more to check here.
c2pa.signedDisclaimer: A signature proves what the signer declared, not ground truth — see “Honest limits”.
c2pa.invalidFact: A C2PA manifest is embedded, but its signature is invalid — the file or its metadata was modified after signing. The manifest's claims cannot be trusted.
c2pa.checkAnywayNote: Statistical checks do not rely on the broken manifest.
c2pa.loading: Checking the C2PA signature locally in your browser — first load fetches the verification library (~11 MB), the file itself is not uploaded.
c2pa.loadingSlow: Still loading — slow connection? You can skip and run the server check instead.
c2pa.tooBig: This file is {size} — the limit is 8 MB. Re-export or compress the image (any PNG/JPEG under 8 MB keeps enough metadata for the checks).
c2pa.badFormat: Unsupported format — PNG or JPEG only. WebP and GIF carry no metadata we can verify; convert the image to PNG first.
c2pa.unreadable: The file could not be read as an image. Try re-saving it as PNG or JPEG.
c2pa.noManifest: No C2PA manifest — the server will check metadata fingerprints and (if configured) an external detector.
c2pa.unavailable: C2PA check is unavailable in this browser — the server check will run without it.

howItWorks.title: Provenance & metadata
howItWorks.body: For images we first look for cryptographic provenance (a C2PA content manifest, checked in your browser — the file never leaves your device for this step) and for generator fingerprints in file metadata: PNG text chunks written by Stable Diffusion UIs (A1111 'parameters', ComfyUI workflow), and camera EXIF. A valid C2PA signature is a definitive answer; metadata hints are strong but can be stripped.

howItWorks.title: Zero-shot perplexity scoring
howItWorks.body: For text and code we measure how 'surprising' the content is to open language models (a Binoculars-style approximation): AI-generated text is usually more predictable to LLMs than human writing. The score is computed per sentence (or per code line), so you can see which segments look machine-generated, and a bootstrap confidence interval shows how stable the estimate is.

howItWorks.title: Model-family attribution
howItWorks.body: When there is enough text, we score it under proxy models for several families (GPT-style, LLaMA, Qwen, Mistral, DeepSeek) and report the most likely source family. This is experimental: families that share training data are easy to confuse, and we say 'unknown' instead of guessing when the margin is small.

howItWorks.title: External second opinion
howItWorks.body: Optionally, a commercial detector (Sapling for text, Sightengine for images) is asked for an independent score when configured on the server. It is used as a second vote, never as the only signal.

honestLimits: Scores are calibrated zones (confident / likely / abstain), not exact percentages — treat the confidence interval as part of the answer.
Short inputs are refused on purpose: under 150 words of text or 40 lines of code, every known method is unreliable.
Human writers — especially non-native English speakers — can be flagged as AI. Edited or paraphrased AI text can pass as human.
Attribution identifies a model family, not a specific model, and only for English text/code today.
